notes.title: Early 1.21 Update
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed
Fixed a bug that allowed harvesting the moment seeds were planted in the farm.
Fixed a problem with footsteps not sounding when an axe or pickaxe is equipped.
Fixed a bug that prevented stripping from wolves.
Hair and other parts of the body now sway with movement

The term "Early version 1.xx" refers to "Version 1.xx of the Early Access," so after the official release, it will become "Version 1.0 of the Official Release."

notes.title: Early 1.2 Update Add Building menu, Food dehydrator
notes.content:
Due to the numerous inquiries, we've implemented a feature that allows you to remove buildings. When you focus your screen perspective on a building and hold down the 'E' key, the building menu will open. Currently, you can only remove or repair structures, but depending on the types of buildings added in the future, more menu options might be included.

Additionally, we've introduced a new building called the 'Food Dehydrator.' This structure allows you to dry food and extend its shelf life. Furthermore, by drying raw meat, you can consume it without the risk of cooking. (Please note that in reality, consuming raw dried meat can be hazardous, so do not attempt this.)

We're planning to continue updating the game with additional content, so please stay tuned for more.

The term 'Early Access version 1.xx' refers to the version of the game during the Early Access phase. After the official release, it will become the 'Official Release version 1.0'."

(Note: This translation might not be exact, as context is key to understanding certain terms and elements accurately.)

notes.title: Early 1.12 Update
notes.content:
A bug that caused player belongings to differ between online and offline save data when using the same save data has been fixed. If you have both sets of save data, you'll now be prompted to choose which data to use upon loading. This change only affects the "player-owned belongings" and doesn't impact other players or structures. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: Early 1.1 Update
notes.content:
The difficulty settings have been changed and adjusted. It's not just a simple name change; various parameters have been altered.
Continuing, if you have any opinions regarding the difficulty settings, it would be greatly appreciated if you could post them on the bulletin board.

Normal: Intended for people new to this game. You can enjoy a relaxed crafting survival experience.
Survival: Geared towards those seeking a challenging survival experience. You can enjoy a tough survival where the goal is to see how many days you can survive.
Save data from before will be changed as follows:

Easy → Normal
Normal → Survival
The following features have been added and issues have been fixed:

Right-click menu or pressing "T" on the keyboard allows you to transfer items to a separate inventory.
After using up consumable items like berries, they will now go into the remembered hotbar slot upon obtaining them again, instead of going into the inventory.
Added a button to craft as many items as possible.
Fixed an issue where ability changes wouldn't revert when unequipping gear.
Fixed a bug where building could occur without consuming items.
The term "Early Access version 1.xx" refers to the version during the early access phase. After the official release, it will become "Release version 1.0".

notes.title: Early 1.03 Update

By the way, "Early Version 1.03" refers to "Version 1.03 of the Early Access version." After the official release, it will be labeled as "Version 1.0" for the full release. I apologize for any confusion.
